quests.instruction: I have wide wings and the ability to sleep upside down. I live flying through the night sky. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the bat! It has wide wings and the ability to sleep upside down and lives flying through the night sky.
quests.funFact: Bats sleep hanging upside down in caves or trees!

quests.instruction: I have long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail. I live in a burrow in the forest. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the rabbit! It has long floppy ears and a fluffy round tail and lives in a burrow in the forest.
quests.funFact: A group of baby rabbits is called a litter!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that is a bird?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has bright, colorful feathers.
quests.explanation: Yes! The parrot is a bird. It lives perched in a colorful jungle tree.
quests.funFact: Some parrots can copy words that people say!

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with a giant fan of colorful tail feathers?
quests.question: A giant fan of colorful tail feathers
quests.hint: This animal usually lives strutting through a garden.
quests.explanation: That's right! The peacock has a giant fan of colorful tail feathers. You can find it strutting through a garden.
quests.funFact: Only the male peacock grows the giant, colorful tail!

quests.instruction: I have a see-through, umbrella-shaped body. I live drifting through the ocean water. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the jellyfish! It has a see-through, umbrella-shaped body and lives drifting through the ocean water.
quests.funFact: Jellyfish have been drifting in oceans longer than dinosaurs existed!

quests.instruction: What do we call a group of flamingos?
quests.question: Flamingo
quests.hint: Think about where flamingos usually live: wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of flamingos is called a flock. They like to stay together wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake.
quests.funFact: Flamingos usually live together in enormous flocks!

quests.instruction: I have a fan of large tail feathers. I live on a farm. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the turkey! It has a fan of large tail feathers and lives on a farm.
quests.funFact: A baby turkey is called a poult!

quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is a bird?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has bright pink feathers and long thin legs.
quests.explanation: Yes! The flamingo is a bird. It lives wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake.
quests.funFact: A flamingo often stands on just one leg to rest!

quests.instruction: A group of rhinos has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Rhino
quests.hint: Think about where rhinos usually live: grazing on the open plains.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of rhinos is called a crash. They like to stay together grazing on the open plains.
quests.funFact: A rhino's horn is made of the same material as your fingernails!

quests.instruction: Which animal lives together in a "colony"?
quests.question: Colony
quests.hint: This animal has wide wings and the ability to sleep upside down.
quests.explanation: That's right! A group of bats is called a colony. You can find them flying through the night sky.
quests.funFact: Bats sleep hanging upside down in caves or trees!

quests.instruction: Which animal has skin that can change color?
quests.question: Skin that can change color
quests.hint: This animal usually lives hiding among jungle leaves.
quests.explanation: That's right! The chameleon has skin that can change color. You can find it hiding among jungle leaves.
quests.funFact: A chameleon's long, sticky tongue shoots out to catch food!

quests.instruction: I have a tiny body and super strong legs. I live marching through the garden. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the ant! It has a tiny body and super strong legs and lives marching through the garden.
quests.funFact: Ants work together and 'talk' using tiny scent trails!

quests.instruction: Which animal has one or two horns and very thick skin?
quests.question: One or two horns and very thick skin
quests.hint: This animal usually lives grazing on the open plains.
quests.explanation: That's right! The rhino has one or two horns and very thick skin. It says "Snort".
quests.funFact: A rhino's horn is made of the same material as your fingernails!

quests.instruction: I have bright, colorful tail feathers. I live in a farmyard at sunrise. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the rooster! It has bright, colorful tail feathers and lives in a farmyard at sunrise.
quests.funFact: Roosters can crow at any time of day, not just morning!

quests.instruction: Who is able to swim and squeeze through tiny gaps? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Swim and squeeze through tiny gaps
quests.hint: This animal lives hiding among ocean rocks.
quests.explanation: Yes! The octopus can swim and squeeze through tiny gaps. It has eight long, wiggly arms.
quests.funFact: An octopus can change color to hide from danger!

quests.instruction: I have a long flowing mane and strong legs. I live on a big open farm. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the horse! It has a long flowing mane and strong legs and lives on a big open farm.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both lying down and standing up!

quests.instruction: I have black and white spots and a gentle moo. I live in a green farm pasture. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the cow! It has black and white spots and a gentle moo and lives in a green farm pasture.
quests.funFact: Cows can sleep while they are standing up!

quests.instruction: I have round black and white patches. I live munching bamboo in a misty forest. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the panda! It has round black and white patches and lives munching bamboo in a misty forest.
quests.funFact: Pandas have a special wrist bone that works like a thumb!

quests.instruction: Which animal lives in a river?
quests.question: In a river
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a huge mouth and short round legs.
quests.explanation: Great job! The hippo lives in a river. You can spot it by a huge mouth and short round legs.
quests.funFact: Hippos can hold their breath underwater for several minutes!

quests.instruction: I have sharp talons and amazing eyesight. I live soaring high above the mountains. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the eagle! It has sharp talons and amazing eyesight and lives soaring high above the mountains.
quests.funFact: An eagle can spot movement from almost two miles away!

quests.instruction: Who is able to crawl and fly short hops? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Crawl and fly short hops
quests.hint: This animal lives resting on a garden leaf.
quests.explanation: Yes! The ladybug can crawl and fly short hops. It has a round red shell with black spots.
quests.funFact: A ladybug's spots can help warn other animals it doesn't taste good!

quests.instruction: I have big round eyes and long jumping legs. I live in a splashy pond. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the frog! It has big round eyes and long jumping legs and lives in a splashy pond.
quests.funFact: A baby frog is called a tadpole and it starts life swimming!

quests.instruction: I have eight legs and a silky web. I live weaving a web in the garden. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the spider! It has eight legs and a silky web and lives weaving a web in the garden.
quests.funFact: A spider can spin a strong, sticky web to catch its food!

quests.instruction: Which animal can gallop in a herd?
quests.question: Gallop in a herd
quests.hint: This animal lives on the grassy plains.
quests.explanation: Yes! The zebra can gallop in a herd. It has black and white stripes from head to tail.
quests.funFact: No two zebras have exactly the same stripe pattern!

quests.instruction: I have a big furry mane around the face. I live prowling the wild savanna grasslands. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the lion! It has a big furry mane around the face and lives prowling the wild savanna grasslands.
quests.funFact: Only male lions usually grow a big furry mane!

quests.instruction: Which animal is a reptile?
quests.question: Reptile
quests.hint: This animal has long jaws and rows of sharp teeth.
quests.explanation: Yes! The crocodile is a reptile. It lives floating quietly in a river.
quests.funFact: A crocodile can hold very still in water while watching for food!

quests.instruction: I have black and white stripes from head to tail. I live on the grassy plains. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the zebra! It has black and white stripes from head to tail and lives on the grassy plains.
quests.funFact: A zebra's stripes may help confuse animals that hunt it!

quests.instruction: I have a giant fan of colorful tail feathers. I live strutting through a garden. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the peacock! It has a giant fan of colorful tail feathers and lives strutting through a garden.
quests.funFact: A peacock's tail feathers can have shiny blue and green eye-spots!

quests.instruction: I have a curved fin and a playful smile. I live leaping through ocean waves. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the dolphin! It has a curved fin and a playful smile and lives leaping through ocean waves.
quests.funFact: Dolphins often swim together in a group called a pod!

quests.instruction: I have a long tail for swinging between trees. I live high in the jungle trees. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the monkey! It has a long tail for swinging between trees and lives high in the jungle trees.
quests.funFact: Monkeys love to eat fruit, especially bananas!
